basis.claim: The subject is documented in depth with 55 evidence records and a cited thesis driver, while the comparable's pack has no thesis, no evidence records and no peers, so there is no positive case to be made for Lowe's on this evidence.
Home Depot shows scale and profitability with $164.7 billion of net sales and $14.2 billion of net earnings ($14.23 per diluted share) in fiscal 2025.

Growth is currently acquisition-led rather than organic, with SRS and GMS contributing roughly $6.3 billion of the $5.2 billion net sales increase and comparable sales up only 0.3%, which is the main reservation on the subject.
Capital return is constrained: buybacks remain paused with no plan to resume in fiscal 2026 while debt is reduced, and the dividend increase was only 1.3%.

Management nonetheless states liquidity from cash, operating cash flow, commercial paper and debt markets should cover operations, dividends and investment through the next several fiscal years, with ~$4 billion of fiscal 2026 capex planned.
